name: Alaina Underwood
source:
Alaina Underwood, otherwise known as "Coach's Daughter". Despite the pigment of her hair, she's in her final year of Pre-Med on her way to an MD after having graduated two years ahead of her own class.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/move-chains-plot-70773805]Patreon[/url]]

Often referred to as “The Coach’s Daughter”. Also known as a key to finding yourself on the bench for the entire season. Is in her final year of pre-med at near the top of her class.

[In game description]
